//: SCP-294 PLACEMENT - VERY RARE, INSIDE EXISTING LABS AND OFFICES.  The machine does not get an overmap special of its own; it is injected into buildings that are already generated, the way the base game scatters map extras through a building's interior.
//2: HOW THE INJECTION WORKS.  A mapgen entry with the same om_terrain as a base building does NOT overlay it - it competes with it in a weighted lottery and REPLACES it when chosen (src/mapgen.cpp:508-530).  So the only clean injection is a map_extra whose generator is an update_mapgen: the map_extra is rolled during the building's own generation and its update_mapgen overlay is applied on top of the finished map.  This is exactly how mx_lab_concourse_area works (data/json/overmap/map_extras.json:255 with its updater in data/json/mapgen/map_extras/lab_extras.json).
//3: RARITY - THE ACTUAL ODDS.  Per eligible map tile: one_in( collection.chance ) x ( our weight / sum of the weights valid at that z ); the one_in and the weighted pick are src/mapgen.cpp:295-296, and out-of-z extras are dropped by filtered_by at src/regional_settings.cpp:853-867.  Our weight is 1 in both pools and the pool totals are pinned by tests/scp_294_test.cpp.  LAB INTERIORS: chance 2, pool total 23752 (every base entry includes z0), so 1_in(2) x 1/23752 = 1 in ~47,500 lab-interior tiles - exactly the odds of the base game's own rarest lab extra, mx_jabberwock, which is also weight 1.  CITY BUILDINGS: chance 90; the stored pool totals 221, but mx_house_spider (weight 40) is basement-only (min_max_zlevel [-1,-1]) and drops out at z0, leaving 181, so 1_in(90) x 1/181 = 1 in ~16,300 building tiles.  Net effect: most worlds will never generate one.  Raise this weight to make it more common - at small weights the odds scale roughly linearly (e.g. 25 makes it about 25x more likely).
//4: TUNING NOTE.  The machine is placed at a fixed coordinate (11,11) with the floor forced under it, so it is always reachable rather than embedded in a wall.  If a particular lab or office layout makes that coordinate look wrong, adjust x/y here (or spread it with a range) - the update_mapgen is the only place the coordinate lives.

//: The map_extra itself.  Its 'generator' points at the update_mapgen above; the base game calls it when this extra is rolled for a tile.
description: A vending machine stands against the wall, humming softly to itself.

//: LABS.  research_facility_interior is the extras collection attached to lab overmap terrains (data/json/overmap/overmap_terrain/overmap_terrain_lab.json); copy-from + extend adds our extra to the base list rather than replacing it (the CrazyCataclysm / MindOverMatter pattern).
OFFICES AND OTHER CITY BUILDINGS.  'build' is the collection offices and similar interiors draw their extras from.  Weight 1 against base weights of 5..40 keeps it a genuine rarity.
